name: random_page_cost
description: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a non-sequentially fetched disk page, influencing join and index scan plan selection.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans (e.g., unnecessary sequential scans)
Poor index usage despite selective predicates
Increased query latency due to inefficient access paths
tuning_tips: Lower values (e.g., 1.0–1.5) favor index scans and are appropriate for fast random I/O (SSDs, high effective_cache_size); higher values (e.g., 3.0–4.0) favor sequential scans and suit HDDs or low cache hit rates. Tune based on observed I/O profile and EXPLAIN output.
default_formula: 4.0 (default), adjust downward proportionally to random I/O speed relative to sequential I/O (e.g., SSD: ~1.0–1.5, NVMe: ~1.0)
